record.title: Uniform upper bound for integer matrices with a prescribed characteristic polynomial
record.statement:
Fix a positive integer $n$. For real $H\ge 1$, let $M_n(\mathbb Z;H)$ be the set of $n\times n$ integer matrices $A=(a_{ij})$ with $|a_{ij}|\le H$, and, for $f\in\mathbb Z[X]$, define
\[
R_n(H;f)=\#\{A\in M_n(\mathbb Z;H):\text{$f$ is the characteristic polynomial of $A$}\}.
\]
**Conjecture.** Uniformly over polynomials $f$, as $H\to\infty$,
\[
R_n(H;f)\le H^{n(n-1)/2+o(1)}.
\]

record.title: Vojta’s conjecture for truncated proximity to a normal-crossing divisor

$$
\sum_{v\in S}\lambda_v(D,P)+h(K,P)<\epsilon h(A,P)+O(1).
$$

record.title: Hopkins–Morel conjecture

\[
MGL/(x_1,x_2,\ldots)\longrightarrow H\mathbb{Z}\in SH(S)
\]

record.title: Uniform asymptotic level of the similarity test
record.statement:
For every significance level $\alpha\in(0,1)$, the constructed test $\phi_T^\eta$ for the similarity hypothesis $H_0$ satisfies
\[
\limsup_{T\to\infty}\sup_{b\in H_0}\mathbb{E}_b\!\left[\phi_T^\eta\right]\le \alpha,
\]
where $T$ is the diffusion-observation time horizon and $H_0$ is the hypothesis that $b_0(x)-\eta\le b(x)\le b_0(x)+\eta$ for every $x\in I$.

record.title: Hamilton conjecture

\[
aR\le \lambda_1\le \lambda_2\le \lambda_3\le R,
\]
for some $a>0$. Then $(M,g)$ is either compact or flat.
